definition: with_transit: walking + actual GTFS rail/bus with uncapped access/egress. walking_only: identical direct walking estimates and no transit.
City folder identifier.
City name.
Populated city-limit tract portions for 11 cities; 70 custom sections for NYC.
Zero-based row/column position in all this city’s matrices.
Exact node identifier: 11-digit tract GEOID in 11 cities; NYC 70-section zone ID in New York. Load as text; matches matrix ordering.
WGS84 representative-point latitude. Eleven cities use the populated-block internal point nearest their population-weighted centroid; NYC retains its saved section representative points.
WGS84 longitude of the same representative point.
2020 population of this city-limit tract portion, or custom section for NYC.
Population of the entire Census tract, including any part outside city limits.
Population of the city portion divided by full tract population. Values below 1 identify tracts with residents outside city limits.
Diagnostic flag for city tract portions with fewer than 100 residents. These are retained to conserve city counts; majority-tract measures can be sensitive to them.
One of White alone, Black alone, Hispanic any race, or Asian alone; groups overlap.
2020 residents of this category within the city tract portion.
group_population / population; fraction in [0,1].
Citywide population fraction of this category, repeated for interpretation.
Largest eigenvalue λ of the city’s A for this category. Same across tracts; it is not a tract-specific eigenvalue.
Node component v_i of the right Perron vector. The vector sums to 1 across each city/category/scenario.
n*v_i with n the city node count; node mean 1. This is a relative eigenvector score, not a probability, city eigenvalue or scalar normalized PSSI.
Maximum absolute residual of A*v - λ*v; numerical error, not segregation.
(P*p)_i, modeled same-category exposure for this tract.
